title: Chinese nationals detained after drone incursions at MacDill and Langley
place_text: MacDill Air Force Base and Langley Air Force Base

tellings.quote: Based on what we know from previous incursions at McDill and Langley Air Force Base this year as well, um, that there were Chinese nationals that were taken into custody.

plain: In 2024, after drones flew into the airspace over MacDill and Langley, two US Air Force bases, Chinese citizens were taken into custody. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he once carried a recovered craft, says this is what is known about those incidents. He brings it up to point to who might be behind some of the drone sightings.
